'''Crystalline vertex''' was a highly valuable [[mineral]] that could be mined.

==Characteristics==
Veins of crystalline vertex varied in purity, with especially pure veins being found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kir]]. After being mined, the vertex was refined and cut into crystals of standard shape and [[Color/Legends|color]] for use as currency within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The plural of crystalline vertex was crystalline vertices.<ref name="PP" />

==History==
Crystalline vertex was the primary currency within the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. Individuals entering the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] were required to exchange their currency into either crystalline vertex or [[Authority Cash Voucher]]s at [[Authority Currency Exchange]]s.<ref name="GSWU" /> Many worlds besides the Corporate Sector also used crystalline vertex as currency. At the time of a [[Incident at the Jedi Temple|string of robberies]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] was holding a large shipment of vertex in its [[treasury room]].<ref name="CT">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Captive Temple]]''</ref>

Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], crystalline vertex was the currency used to fund [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] pet project that reached fruition in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]] with passage of [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] legislation that created the [[All Planets Relief Fund]]—which, bypassing the standard quagmire of bureaucratic policy and procedure, provided immediate relief to imperiled worlds. The vertex treasury (contributed to by multiple Senate-member worlds) was safeguarded in its [[Bank of the Core/Legends|Bank of the Core]] vault on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant.]] The All Planets treasury funded one central account, from which all critical-relief funding was transferred and dispersed to troubled worlds throughout the galaxy.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>
